title: Transition
description: A transition applied between two adjacent clips on a Timeline. `type` selects a plugin from the Transition Engine's registry (packages/video-composition-sdk `ITransitionPlugin` + `TRANSITION_PLUGIN_REGISTRY`) - `cinematic_cut`/`fade_in`/`fade_out`/`dissolve`/`match_cut`/`wipe`/`whip_pan`/`zoom` are the built-in plugins (the first five map 1:1 onto shot.schema.json's transition_in/transition_out vocabulary - see TimelineBuilder); `custom` requires `plugin_id` naming a separately-registered plugin. See docs/adr/0012-post-production-pipeline.md.

duration_sec.description: 0 for cinematic_cut (a hard cut, no overlap); every other type overlaps the two adjacent clips by this much.

plugin_id.description: Required when type=custom - the TRANSITION_PLUGIN_REGISTRY key of a custom ITransitionPlugin.

params.description: Plugin-specific parameters (e.g. whip_pan's direction, zoom's in/out).
